short_bio: American basketball player and the NBA’s all-time leading scorer.
biography:
LeBron James was born in Akron, Ohio, and attended St. Vincent–St. Mary High School. The Cleveland Cavaliers took him first overall in the 2003 NBA draft.

He won NBA championships with the Miami Heat in 2012 and 2013, the Cavaliers in 2016 and the Los Angeles Lakers in 2020. He has been named the league’s Most Valuable Player four times.

In February 2023 he passed Kareem Abdul-Jabbar as the league’s all-time leading scorer. He has won Olympic gold three times, in 2008, 2012 and 2024. In 2024 he and his son Bronny became the first father and son to play together in an NBA game.
